title: I made a 2D online power fantasy game using Claude
author: DarkWaterWeb
selftext:
Sunscar is a 2D online action sandbox: you wake up weak in a world the sun burns down every 14 days, then train, fight, join factions and transform before the flare. It runs in the browser, on iPhone (App Store), and on a headless server for the shared online world.

The reason for why the "sun burns down" is because if there wasnt any sort of wipe system implemented then the strong players would constantly shit on the weaker ones :p

Link to play is in the comments below (idk, reddit doesnt like when I paste links in)

**How AI was used:**

\- Code: I directed Claude Code, an AI coding agent, and it wrote basically all the GDScript in Godot 4.7. That covers combat, the world generator, server-authoritative WebSocket netcode, the iOS plugin for Sign in with Apple and in-app purchases, and the UI.

\- Art: the character bases are openly licensed Liberated Pixel Cup sprites. The AI wrote Python scripts that paint on top of them: transformation forms, outfits, a mechanical race, pets, mounts, and the masks for hair, skin and eye colour. So technically not image generation although I am hiring pixel artists!

\- Shipping: the AI also handled builds, deploys and most of the App Store submission. I approved anything that cost money or went to Apple.

Happy to answer questions about the workflow. Feedback on the game is very welcome (specifically: do you know what you're doing and do you like the combat/the feeling of getting stronger?)
